purpose: Record a surviving obligation from COMPLETE_WITH_SUCCESSOR_OBLIGATION without implicitly creating, accepting or authorizing an amendment, renewal or successor engagement.

ORIGINAL_ACCEPTED_TERMS_CONTINUATION: exact accepted proposal/SOW/version expressly contains the surviving obligation
obligation scope, owner and applicable term/trigger are already fixed by accepted evidence
performing the obligation does not materially change price/scope/deliverables/exclusions/schedule/liability/authority/payment or another accepted material term
AMENDMENT_OR_RENEWAL_REQUIRED: surviving obligation belongs to the same commercial relationship but performance requires changing or extending a material accepted term
StegBusiness-Ops AMENDED or RENEWAL_DUE/renewal evidence path is applicable
no amended/renewed authority is inferred from the handoff record
SEPARATE_SUCCESSOR_ENGAGEMENT_REQUIRED: follow-on work is outside the exact accepted scope or was expressly separately quoted/contracted/governed
new bounded scope/pricing/acceptance/professional or other material terms must be separately admitted
source engagement identity and closure remain unchanged
FAIL_CLOSED_UNCLASSIFIED: accepted source terms do not establish whether the obligation continues, requires amendment/renewal, or requires separate engagement

proposal_versioning_boundary: A material modification to accepted price, scope, deliverables, exclusions, schedule, liability, authority, payment or other material terms is not acceptance of the existing proposal/version; it requires a new proposal/version or explicit separately resolved amendment.
contract_lifecycle_boundary: StegBusiness-Ops owns AMENDED / RENEWAL_DUE and related contract lifecycle evidence. This record does not transition those states.

work_authorization.rule: Recording or classifying a successor obligation never authorizes work. ORIGINAL_ACCEPTED_TERMS_CONTINUATION still requires the obligation's trigger/due condition and applicable operational/service-start evidence. AMENDMENT_OR_RENEWAL_REQUIRED requires authentic amended/renewed acceptance/execution as applicable. SEPARATE_SUCCESSOR_ENGAGEMENT_REQUIRED requires a separately proposed and accepted engagement plus its normal delivery-admission/service-start path.

source_closure_immutability: The source engagement retains COMPLETE_WITH_SUCCESSOR_OBLIGATION. Later amendment, renewal, successor-engagement, performance or resolution evidence does not rewrite that historical closure disposition.
prohibitions: No work authorization from record existence
No repository state treated as commercial authority
